ValidationRule.description: Billing Team must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (RecordType_Name__c = "CLAS - RM") && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_Email_Sent_To_Contracts_Admin__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Email_Sent_To_Contracts_Admin__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_Email_Sent_To_Contracts_Admin__c) != TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_Email_Sent_To_Contracts_Admin__c)) || DATEVALUE(Date_Email_Sent_To_Contracts_Admin__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_Email_Sent_To_Contracts_Admin__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Email_Sent_To_Contracts_Admin__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_Email_Sent_To_Contracts_Admin__c) != TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Billing Team must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
